age_minimum.quote: The person shall be 21 or more years of age and a citizen or legal resident of the United States

moral_character_required.quote: to be eligible to be certified to install, improve, repair or maintain medical gas piping, an applicant shall be of good moral character

degree_required.value: bachelor's degree in mechanical, plumbing or sanitary engineering from an accredited college or university (alternative pathway) OR completion of a plumbing apprenticeship program accredited and approved by the United States Department of Labor
degree_required.quote: The person shall have been awarded a bachelor's degree in mechanical, plumbing or sanitary engineering from an accredited college or university in the United States which the board finds acceptable

accrediting_body.value: United States Department of Labor (for apprenticeship); board-approved accredited college or university (for engineering degree pathway)
accrediting_body.quote: Four years of the five years shall have been spent in a plumbing apprenticeship program accredited and approved by the United States Department of Labor

degree_level.quote: The person shall have been engaged or employed in the plumbing trade for a period of five years preceding the date of his application for a State license.

school_approval_basis.quote: a bachelor's degree in mechanical, plumbing or sanitary engineering from an accredited college or university in the United States which the board finds acceptable

credential_pegged.quote: any person desiring to obtain a State master plumber's license shall make application to the State board to be licensed as described herein and shall pay all the fees required in connection therewith, and be examined as herein required

required.quote: The person shall have been engaged or employed in the plumbing trade for a period of five years preceding the date of his application for a State license. One of the five years shall have been spent while engaged or employed as a journeyman plumber.

experience_source.quote: The person shall have been engaged or employed in the plumbing trade for a period of five years preceding the date of his application for a State license. One of the five years shall have been spent while engaged or employed as a journeyman plumber.

duration.value: 5 years (including 1 year as journeyman plumber and 4 years in an accredited apprenticeship program)
duration.quote: The person shall have been engaged or employed in the plumbing trade for a period of five years preceding the date of his application for a State license. One of the five years shall have been spent while engaged or employed as a journeyman plumber. Four years of the five years shall have been spent in a plumbing apprenticeship program accredited and approved by the United States Department of Labor

kind.value: plumbing trade employment including journeyman and apprenticeship
kind.quote: One of the five years shall have been spent while engaged or employed as a journeyman plumber. Four years of the five years shall have been spent in a plumbing apprenticeship program accredited and approved by the United States Department of Labor

exams.name: State Master Plumber's License Examination
exams.notes: Examination may be theoretical or practical or both; held at least 4 times per year. Persons who failed must wait 6 months before re-examination.
exams.jurisdiction: state (New Jersey State Board of Examiners of Master Plumbers)
exams.quote: Every State master plumber's license examination shall be substantially uniform and shall be designed so as to establish the competence and qualifications of the applicant to perform the type of work and business as described by this act.

interval_years.quote: Licenses may be renewed annually by the State board upon written application of the holder and payment of the prescribed fee and renewal of required bond.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Annual renewal of master plumber's State license .......... $ 50.00

required.quote: The State Board of Examiners of Master Plumbers shall require each master plumber, as a condition for biennial license renewal pursuant to section 18 of P.L.1968, c.362 (C.45:14C-18), to complete any continuing education requirements imposed by the board pursuant to section 2 of this act.

hours_per_period.quote: the number of credits required shall not exceed five in any biennial license period

period_years.quote: the number of credits required shall not exceed five in any biennial license period

available.quote: The State board may in its discretion grant State licenses without examination to applicants so licensed by other States; provided that equal reciprocity is provided for New Jersey master plumbers by law of such applicant's domiciliary State and provided further that such sister State's standards are equal to or comparable to those of this State.

requirements.value: Equal reciprocity must be provided for NJ master plumbers by the applicant's home state, and that state's standards must be equal to or comparable to NJ standards.
requirements.quote: provided that equal reciprocity is provided for New Jersey master plumbers by law of such applicant's domiciliary State and provided further that such sister State's standards are equal to or comparable to those of this State.

exists.quote: There is created hereunder a State Board of Examiners of Master Plumbers in the Department of Law and Public Safety

national_certification.value: National Inspection Testing and Certification Corporation (NITC)
national_certification.quote: has passed an examination offered by the National Inspection Testing and Certification Corporation (NITC), or a substantially equivalent examination approved by the State board

national_association.value: National Fire Protection Association; American Welding Society; American Society of Sanitary Engineering
national_association.quote: has successfully completed not less than 32 hours of classroom training relating to the most recent edition of the Standard on Gas and Vacuum Systems issued by the National Fire Protection Association

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transferring or assigning a state license to another person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any license which shall have been found to have been so transferred or assigned shall be suspended or revoked by the State board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking plumbing work without first posting the required surety bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no master plumber who is the holder of a license under the provisions of this act shall undertake to do any plumbing work in the State of New Jersey or any political subdivision thereof unless and until he shall have first entered into a bond

disciplinary_grounds.description: Working as or holding oneself out as a master plumber without a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: any person, firm, partnership, corporation or other legal entity that knowingly violates any provision of this section shall be guilty of a crime of the fourth degree.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in or advertising as a plumbing contractor without authorization.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a person, firm, partnership, corporation or other legal entity shall not engage in the business of plumbing contracting or advertise in any manner as a plumbing contractor or use the title or designation of plumbing contractor unless authorized

bonding_required.quote: no master plumber who is the holder of a license under the provisions of this act shall undertake to do any plumbing work in the State of New Jersey or any political subdivision thereof unless and until he shall have first entered into a bond in favor of the State of New Jersey in the sum of $3,000.00 executed by a surety company

definition_quote.value: Plumbing means the practice, materials and fixtures used in the installation, maintenance, extension, alteration, repair and removal of all piping, plumbing fixtures, plumbing appliances and plumbing apparatus in connection with any of the following: sanitary drainage, storm facilities and building sewers to their respective final connection to an approved point of disposal, venting systems, public and private water supply systems of any premises to and within the property line of any building, structure or conveyance to their final connection with an approved supply system.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" means the practice, materials and fixtures used in the installation, maintenance, extension, alteration, repair and removal of all piping, plumbing fixtures, plumbing appliances and plumbing apparatus in connection with any of the following: sanitary drainage, storm facilities and building sewers to their respective final connection to an approved point of disposal, venting systems, public and private water supply systems of any premises to and within the property line of any building, structure or conveyance to their final connection with an approved supply system.

methods_authorized.quote: the installation, maintenance, extension, alteration, repair and removal of all piping, plumbing fixtures, plumbing appliances and plumbing apparatus

license_tiers.quote: "Apprentice plumber" means any person other than a master plumber or journeyman plumber who as his principal occupation is engaged in learning and assisting in the installation of plumbing; "Journeyman plumber" means any person other than a master plumber or apprentice plumber who installs, alters, repairs and renovates plumbing

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: A journeyman plumber works under the supervision of a master plumber; apprentice plumbers work under the supervision of a master plumber as part of their principal occupation of learning and assisting.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: "Journeyman plumber" means any person other than a master plumber or apprentice plumber who installs, alters, repairs and renovates plumbing in accordance with standards, rules and regulations established by the board and who works under the supervision of a master plumber

value: Completion of a plumbing apprenticeship program accredited and approved by the United States Department of Labor
Employment in the plumbing trade or enrollment in a formal plumbing apprenticeship program (transitional credit for four years following effective date of P.L.1998, c.96)
journeyman_experience_pathways.quote: Four years of the five years shall have been spent in a plumbing apprenticeship program accredited and approved by the United States Department of Labor, with proof of passage and successful completion of this program while actively engaged or employed as a plumbing apprentice. For a period of four years following the effective date of P.L.1998, c.96, each year of employment in the plumbing trade or enrollment in a formal plumbing apprenticeship program shall be accepted by the State board in lieu of one year's enrollment in a plumbing apprenticeship program accredited and approved by the United States Department of Labor

master_plumber_supervisory_experience_re.quote: One of the five years shall have been spent while engaged or employed as a journeyman plumber.

expedited_licensure_pathway_available.quote: The State board shall, upon application to it and payment of the prescribed fee, issue a State master plumber's license without examination to any person who held a plumber's license issued by a municipality, local board of health or other agency for at least five years prior to the effective date of this 1987 amendatory and supplementary act

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: In order to act as "a plumbing contractor," a licensed master plumber shall be the holder of not less than 10% of the issued and outstanding shares of stock in the corporation, or not less than 10% of the capital of the partnership, or not less than 10% of the ownership of any other firm or legal entity engaging in the business of plumbing contracting in the State

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: another bona fide representative of such entity obtains for a State license within 6 months from the date of such death, illness or disability

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: The provisions of this amendatory and supplementary act shall not apply to a single family home owner who performs plumbing work on his own dwelling.

continuing_education_hours_plumber.quote: the number of credits required shall not exceed five in any biennial license period
